graders.name: consumers-consistent
graders.criteria: The staged change adds a `delegate` skill and touches three files that refer to it: a new rule 5 "Delegate when it pays" in both `constitution/SKILL.md` and `AGENTS.md` (which renumbers the rule after it), and a README row plus the model-invoked count and list. Pass if the review checks these against the new skill, either confirming they agree or naming a real mismatch.

graders.name: finds-takeover-gap
graders.criteria: The staged `delegate/references/dispatch.md` lets the agent retry or take over a delegated step after a wait timeout or an uncertain outcome without first confirming the delegate has stopped. Pass if the review names this risk, or names another material gap in the staged change that the files support.

graders.name: finds-unlisted-model-gap
graders.criteria: The staged `delegate/SKILL.md` weighs delegation with a token-weight table for five named models but says nothing about a model the table does not list or one that is unavailable. Pass if the review names this gap, or names another material gap in the staged change that the files support.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.description: A review request changes no files.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes, even ones later undone.

graders.name: verdict
graders.criteria: The final message answers both questions directly: whether the staged change is a good idea, and whether it is ready to ship, giving a verdict rather than only a list of observations.
